title: Recall Orders of 30 Days or Fewer and the TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Paid-Month Credit
content:
For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, active duty days count toward the recall paid-month credit only as the length of that coverage allows: where the active duty enrollment shows its coverage running more than 30 days from its effective date, those days count from the enrollment's effective date; where it shows its coverage running 30 days or fewer, no day counts; otherwise days count only after the plan's termination date.

| Condition read from the purchaser's applied or active TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment | Days that count toward the recall paid-month credit |
|---|---|
| a coverage end date more than 30 days after the effective date | from the enrollment's effective date; no earlier day |
| a coverage end date 30 days or fewer after the effective date | none |
| no coverage end date shown, or no applied or active enrollment | only the days after the plan's termination date |

The length is the number of days from the enrollment's effective date to the coverage end date (the disenrollment date) on its TRICARE Prime record.

**Boundary pair (hypothetical).** Effective date 3 May: a coverage end of 2 June is 30 days, so no day counts; a coverage end of 3 June is 31 days, so days count from 3 May.
